compatibility_baseline.accepted_v1_behavior: Ordinary non-execution PipelineDocument parse/plan/CLI and ordinary v1 lifecycle capture remain byte-identical; canonical JSON/hash recipe unchanged (sorted keys, compact, ASCII, NaN refused).

actors_and_authority.untrusted_input: application/fixture callers can supply closed data, mutate their original data after factory return, call all public lifecycle/facade methods, pass forged/cross-broker handles, and race operations. JSON documents are untrusted input.
actors_and_authority.trusted_authorities: broker-held fixed signer/keyring/clock/revocation authorities and the fixed external terminal-verification authority are trust roots, never caller choices. Only LifecycleAuthority writes admission/capture/session state.
actors_and_authority.sole_writer: The existing same-ledger sole writer from Packet 4 is the single authoritative writer; no second writer, planner, ledger, or tape engine may be introduced.
actors_and_authority.not_a_boundary: Mutable Python internals (constructor __kwdefaults__ tuples, intern tables, process-local locks, object identity) are not a durable security boundary.

f5a_r23.summary: HistoricalStudyVerifier.capture reads type(self).__init__.__kwdefaults__['_spend'][:2] (verifier.py:820); the _spend default pair (set(), set(), {}) created by _make_spend_pair (verifier.py:654) is a public constructor kwdefault tuple. A caller can walk __kwdefaults__.values(), update live with spent and clear spent, so one bound instance writes two CAPTURED events.
f5a_r23.holding: consume-once stays stopped and not ReviewExited (owner decisions 0028/0029 on the preserved source). Do not relabel as ADR-0126-deferred. Packet 6 must not overclaim durability; only Packet 8 may resolve this via an owner-approved durable authority boundary.
f5a_r23.disposition_until: Retained open until the Packet 8 owner decision and GREEN proof.

packet6_equality_and_restart: one authorization silently becoming a second consumption authority

cross_owner_decision_requested.why: Packet 5's $captured_artifact descriptor grammar and its only-legal-location enforcement is parser/plan/CLI work in the F1 (model-release) lane. forecast-capital (F5a) does not own these files. The master plan F1 section and ADR-0125 specify the grammar, but an ownership correction/approval is required before forecast-capital edits F1 parser surfaces.

packet6_vs_packet8_separation.packet6: Proves descriptor/receipt equality and fail-closed restart identity only. It binds descriptor, derived port, published root/receipt, producer, member manifest, captured receipt, authorization entry, run, process, purpose, and session identities. It must NOT claim durable consume-once or reconstruction.
packet6_vs_packet8_separation.packet8: Owns durable mutable state, transaction and locking semantics, crash/restart recovery, idempotency key, unknown-outcome resolver, and authority for admission consumption and unspend refusal. Requires an owner decision naming the owning process/service before any code.
